guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.intro: Our Pins is a small, invite-only community of Greeks living in Japan.

rules.title: Vouch for places you actually know
rules.body: A pin or a vouch means "I've been here and I'd send a friend." Don't recommend places you haven't experienced yourself.

rules.title: Keep it real and relevant
rules.body: No spam, ads, or repeated self-promotion. Share things that genuinely help the community.

rules.title: Respect people's privacy
rules.body: Don't share another member's personal details, photos, or contact info without their consent.

rules.title: High-stakes tips are opinions, not professional advice
rules.body: Recommendations for doctors, lawyers, therapists, accountants and the like are personal experiences from members — not a substitute for qualified professional advice. Use your own judgment.

rules.title: Post in good faith on the Board and Resources
rules.body: Board = real needs (jobs, housing, events); Resources = lasting references. Quality over quantity.

rules.title: Admins keep the space healthy
rules.body: Admins may remove content or a member's access if needed. See something off? Tell the admin.

guidelines.closing: Questions, or something feel wrong? Message an admin. Thanks for helping keep Our Pins a place we all trust.

guide.title: How Our Pins works
guide.intro: A quick tour of everything you can do here.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A private map of places we trust — restaurants, doctors, weekend trips and more — each vouched for by a member. If it's pinned, someone here has actually been.

sections.title: Finding a place
sections.body: Browse the pins on the map. Use the Categories dropdown to filter by type and see how many of each there are, then tap a pin to see who vouched and what they said.

sections.title: Adding a place
sections.body: Tap any spot on the map, or use the + button. If nobody's pinned it yet, pick a category and write why you'd send a friend — that's your first vouch.

sections.title: Vouching and photos
sections.body: On a place someone already pinned, tap "I've been here too" and add a comment if you like. On your own pins you can add up to four photos.

sections.title: Board and Resources
sections.body: The Board is for time-limited needs — jobs, housing, things for sale, events — and posts leave the board after 30 days. Resources is a permanent library of how-tos and things worth watching or reading.

sections.title: Parea, our assistant
sections.body: Tap the chat bubble to ask Parea for a recommendation. It answers only from what the community has shared — pins, vouches, member bios, the Board and Resources — and points you to members by name.

sections.title: Language and dark mode
sections.body: Switch between Greek and English, or light and dark, with the toggles at the top right. Members' notes are auto-translated, with a tap to see the original.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: Our Pins is a private, invite-only community map for members of the Greek community in Japan. It is run by community volunteers, not a company. This page explains what personal data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectSignIn: Sign-in information: your LINE user ID, name, and profile picture. LINE does not give us your email address. (Admins who sign in with Google or email also share that email address.)
privacy.collectProfile: Profile information you provide: display name, optional photo, optional full name (visible to admins only), an optional short bio, and optional links (Instagram, LinkedIn, website).
privacy.collectContent: Content you post: places you pin, vouches, comments, photos, noticeboard posts, and resources.
privacy.collectParea: Questions you ask Parea: when you use our assistant — in the app or over LINE — we log your questions and its answers so the app's operator can monitor usage and prevent abuse.
privacy.collectFeedback: Feedback you send: bug reports and suggestions, along with which page you were on; visible to admins only.
privacy.lineBody: When you sign in with LINE, we receive your LINE user ID, display name, and profile picture. LINE does not share your email address with us; internally we store a placeholder address that is never used to send mail. Once you're a member, your LINE profile picture is imported automatically as your starting photo — you can replace or remove it any time in Settings. If you sign in without a valid invite, a minimal account record is created; ask an admin to remove it if you don't join.
privacy.digestTitle: Weekly recap in our LINE group
privacy.digestBody: Once a week, our bot posts a short recap to the community's LINE group: names of newly pinned places, titles of new Board posts and Resources, and the display names of new members. The bot does not read or store other messages in the group. If you'd rather not appear in a recap, tell an admin.
privacy.useVerify: To verify that you are an invited member and keep the community private.
privacy.useShow: To show your profile and contributions to other members.
privacy.useManage: To let admins manage invitations and membership.
privacy.useNote: Your email address (where we have one) is visible only to admins, never to other members. We do not send marketing messages.
privacy.storeTitle: Where your data is stored and who processes it
privacy.storeBody: Data is stored with Supabase (Tokyo, Japan); the app is served by Vercel; map data comes from Google Maps. Content you post — pin notes, vouches, Board posts, Resources, member bios and display names — and the questions you ask Parea may be processed by Anthropic's Claude API to provide translations and answers; this content is not used to train AI models. Recaps and bot replies are delivered through LINE. We never sell your data and never share it for advertising — it goes only to these service providers, as needed to run the features described here. The “Files” link in the menu leads to a shared Google Drive folder governed by Google's terms, not this policy.
privacy.retentionBody: Parea logs and feedback are kept until deleted by the operator; expired Board posts are hidden from the app but kept in the database.
privacy.choicesBody: You can edit your profile at any time in Settings. You can delete your account from Settings → Danger zone: your pins are removed from the map, your vouches on other members' pins remain shown anonymously as “Former member”, and your profile, photo, and private details are permanently erased. For any questions or data requests, contact a community admin.
